beats.role_note: COLD OPEN LAW — ask shown answered; Hello Novia
beats.narration_text: Hello Novia. This file is nanotechnology in cancer: tiny carriers for drugs, imaging, and both at once. A fact-check is a workbook, not a vibe. One hundred sixty-eight sentences, three sheets. Here is how that report gets built.

props.command: claude "build the Chapter 28 fact-check workbook: nanotechnology in cancer; count every sentence; split AI-only vs web-flagged; then the editorial sheet"

beats.role_note: FRAMEWORK — four moves that generate the report
beats.narration_text: The science is nanoparticles: delivery, imaging, theranostics. The report is four moves. Count every sentence. Send statistics, guidelines, approvals, evidence, specialist claims, and dated facts to the web. Mark the rest AI-only, each with a reason it was not googled. Then an editorial sheet for the text against itself, and a reread of the AI-only pile for inverted mechanisms. Skip a step, and it is not a review.
beats.visual_intent: Layer stack: count/split · sheet B · editorial + reread

layers.title: 1 — Count, then split
layers.sub: Every sentence: web-flagged (STAT, guideline, approval, evidence, specialist, current) or AI-only

layers.title: 2 — Sheet B keeps the reason
layers.sub: AI-only is classified, not googled — that decision is the record

layers.title: 3 — Editorial, then reread
layers.sub: Sheet C: the file vs itself. Then reread Sheet B for inverted mechanisms

props.caption: Nanotech is the topic. The workbook is the review.

beats.narration_text: First reconstruction. Into Claude: write the ledger from the Chapter 28 counts. One hundred sixty-eight total. Fifty-four go to the web. Split the one hundred fourteen AI-only by the six files, in reading order.

props.command:
claude "write ch28_ledger.py from the Chapter 28 fact-check:
  TOTAL=168
  FLAGGED=54  (web: STAT/GUIDELINE/APPROVAL/EVIDENCE/SPECIALIST/CURRENT)
  AI-ONLY by file: Intro 9, Delivery 30, Clinic 33,
    Imaging 17, Theranostics 18, Summary 7
  print the first-pass ledger"

beats.narration_text: The constants are the file: one hundred sixty-eight, fifty-four flagged, one hundred fourteen AI-only. The by-file dict is the AI-only pile. Assert they sum, so a file cannot vanish. First pass only prints the fifty-four. That is a partial report — steps one and two, with sheet B missing.

props.title: ch28_ledger.py
props.sparkLine: A split with no AI-only sheet is incomplete.

beats.role_note: Manim: 114 vs 54, then AI-only bars by file
beats.narration_text: The split, on screen. One hundred fourteen AI-only on the left. Fifty-four sent to the web on the right. Bars are the one hundred fourteen by file — Clinic is the fat one, thirty-three sentences. Delivery is thirty. A report that only publishes the fifty-four has dropped the classifier's no.
beats.visual_intent: Two big numbers 114 / 54; six terracotta bars of AI-only by file

beats.narration_text: Nanotechnology in cancer is the topic. The report is generated in four moves: count, split, editorial, reread. Three sheets. Hide sheet B and you cannot audit the classifier. Skip sheet C and the file's own duplicates and reversed mechanisms ship.

shot.show: verdict artifact of the four-move protocol

props.artifactTitle: How the Chapter 28 report is generated
artifactLines: Split: 54 web-flagged, 114 AI-only with a reason.
Editorial sheet: 13 findings — duplicates, encoding, reversed PEG.
Reread the 114: 3 flags, including PEG and siRNA backwards.

beats.role_note: HANDOFF LAW — rubric on the next chapter
beats.narration_text: Your turn. Paste this on another chapter. Name the topic in one line, then build the three sheets before you argue with any one sentence. Score it: every sentence counted? AI-only sheet with a reason per row? At least one same-file contradiction on the editorial sheet? If any of those is missing, it is not a finished report.

props.command:
claude "Generate the fact-check report for the next chapter.
(0) One-line topic (what the file is about).
(1) Count every sentence. Split AI-ONLY vs web-flagged (STAT/GUIDELINE/APPROVAL/EVIDENCE/SPECIALIST/CURRENT).
(2) AI-ONLY sheet: file, sentence, why it was not googled.
(3) Editorial sheet: duplicates, grammar, reversed mechanisms.
(4) Reread AI-ONLY for inverted mechanisms.
Score: topic named? every sentence counted? reasons on sheet B? at least one same-file contradiction?"
